display_title: HORIZON-CL5-2027-03-D5-15 Prospective evaluation of nuclear power potential for shipping (ZEWT Partnership) – Horizon Europe
call_module_title: HORIZON-CL5-2027-03-D5-15 Prospective evaluation of nuclear power potential for shipping (ZEWT Partnership)
executive_summary: Horizon Europe Coordination and Support Action under the ZEWT partnership (Zero Emission Waterborne Transport) that funds an assessment of nuclear propulsion for commercial shipping, including small modular reactors: an R&I roadmap, a map of regulatory regimes, use and damage scenarios, implications for National Energy and Climate Plans, total cost of ownership, and safety, training and operational guidelines, covering technical feasibility, economics, safety and security, environmental impact, the legal framework and skills. Open to consortia under the standard Horizon Europe rules; funded as a lump sum at up to 100% of costs. Indicative topic budget EUR 2 million for one project of around EUR 2 million. Planned opening 15 December 2026; single-stage deadline 14 April 2027.
status_rationale: Horizon Europe Work Programme 2026–2027 Part 8 (Climate, Energy and Mobility), pp. 248–251, Specific conditions, Expected Outcome and Scope of HORIZON-CL5-2027-03-D5-15, funds a study and roadmap on the feasibility, safety, economics and regulation of nuclear-powered commercial ships. It does not touch TenneT's field: the subject is on-board ship propulsion and maritime regulation, with no link to electricity transmission, offshore grid connections or system operation, and no project file is close to it. Both project dates are null because the call states no start, end or duration.
